name: Morpho Blue core

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Owned by a 5-of-9 Safe (nine plain EOA signers, no module, no guard) with no timelock, so any 5 signers can act immediately. The owner’s powers are limited to transferring ownership, enabling new rate models and LLTVs, and setting per-market fees (capped at 25% of interest) and the fee recipient, with no function to move user funds, pause the contract, or change an existing market’s oracle, rate model or LLTV.
narrative.detail: The oracle score of 100 means not applicable, not safe: this owner has no power over any market’s price source, but per-market oracle authority is a separate target shape not yet scored. Within Tempo no signer is shared with another tracked target, but the same 9 signers at the same 5-of-9 threshold also control the Morpho Blue owner Safe on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain. Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20: that cross-ecosystem overlap is folded into crossExposureScore as a flat 80 (composite unchanged). The Safe address differs from Ethereum’s, so the scorer’s dated snapshot holds the owner set, not an address, and records the finding in the target’s notes (crossChainSignerOverlap). The core is immutable (no proxy) and no protocol fee is active today (feeRecipient reads the zero address and every market reads a fee of 0).

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
